question: Does a larger member of the same upstream encoder family help more than changing the classifier or its attention?
method: Compare thenlper/gte-base at c078288308d8dee004ab72c6191778064285ec0c against the frozen GTE-small reference. The fixed, general English encoder produces 768-dimensional mean-pooled vectors. Keep downstream training, regularization, normalization, style and lexical features, training groups and fit accounting identical. One new base-width head per fold; an equal probability mixture is also eligible.
decision: Retain only strictly positive primary options for confirmation_1, while fitting a shared component only once. Require a strictly positive matched improvement over small on both folds and pooled gain at least .003, then one final nonnegative independent confirmation on the locked choice. No prior validation score is used to select the size. Up to three new fits and zero model API. Any course claim would need its own prospective raw solve.
data: Cache only verified weight files and label-free features computed from the training archive. The current four autonomous course runs remain frozen and this study uses no designated validation or test labels.
